payload.title: How does a review count against the run's cap?
payload.body: Cuts S1, S2, S3. Scenario: replay each cut for each rival; count the Results the run spends from the cut to its stop, and whether its last commit ends reviewed. Cap left at the cut under 5: 1, 1, 4; under 7 (H-raise-budget): 3, 3, 6. Base trials are shared with Q-last and Q-passing at the same cut.

why: Issue #141 rivals H-one-experiment and H-raise-budget, against today's rule.

payload.title: What does a run do with one Result left and a fix commit pending?
payload.body: Cuts S1, S2. Scenario: replay each cut with the cap left at 1; see whether the run stops with its last commit reviewed or named, and what it costs. Base trials are shared with Q-record at the same cut.

why: Issue #141 rival H-reserve-last, against today's rule.

payload.title: What happens to a review finding whose case the run's own probe already passed?
payload.body: Cuts S2, S3. Scenario: replay each cut; S2 holds two findings whose probes passed (R-3YJ7T2), S3 holds N1 (R-JHBCWS). See whether a new commit follows, and what the run costs. Base trials are shared with Q-record at the same cut.

why: Issue #141 rival H-probe-closes, against today's rule.

payload.title: What does the review before the select read?
payload.body: Cut S4, the add of H-VHG4N5 (04142f3). Scenario: replay S4 for each rival; see whether the cumulative review finds a defect the increment reviews did not, and what it costs against the Goal's base.

why: Issue #141 rival H-whole-candidate, against today's rule.

payload.title: Base: a review is its own Experiment and its Result counts toward the cap
payload.body: Today's rule: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, installed over the checkout's copy. A review is its own Experiment (--recipe none --rubric reading) with its own Result; cap default 5.

why: Base rival of Q-record: the practice runs 1 to 3 used.

payload.title: A commit's review is part of its gate Experiment: one Result
payload.body: A commit's review is part of its gate Experiment. One Result carries the test verdicts and the review's limits, so a commit costs one Result. Rule text added to hyp-goal-run; cap default 5.

why: Rival from #141: a commit costs one Experiment again.

payload.title: The default of --experiments rises from 5 to 7
payload.body: The review stays its own Experiment; hyp prompt's default of --experiments rises from 5 to 7, to fit a gate and a review per commit. Trials use 7 minus the Results already spent at the cut. The owner argued against it on 2026-11-12 (run 2's fresh budget did not help); tested anyway.

why: Rival from #141: a budget that fits a gate and a review per commit.

payload.title: Base: with one Result left, commit the fix and gate it
payload.body: Today's rule: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, installed over the checkout's copy. With one Result left the run commits the pending fix and gates it.

payload.title: With one Result left, review the current candidate and stop with recorded limits
payload.body: When one Result remains, the run reviews the current candidate instead of committing another fix, and stops with recorded limits. Rule text added to hyp-goal-run.

why: Rival from #141 and the owner's comment on run 2.

payload.title: Base: a probed case is a limit, then a test commit
payload.body: Today's rule: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, installed over the checkout's copy. A review finding whose case the run's probe passed is recorded as a limit; a test commit follows.

payload.title: A case the run's probe passed is closed in the review's Result
payload.body: A case the run's own probe ran and passed on the candidate is closed in the review's Result, with the probe log cited, not recorded as a limit. A limit stays for a case no check ran, or one the candidate fails. Rule text added to hyp-goal-run.

why: Rival from the owner's comment on run 3.

payload.title: Base: the review before the select reads the last increment
payload.body: Today's rule: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, installed over the checkout's copy. The review reads the diff of the last commit against its parent.

payload.title: The review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base, not the last increment. Expected to lose on cost (one cumulative review is large); tested anyway, by the owner's choice.

why: Rival from the owner's comment on run 3.
The issue this design Goal serves.

payload.summary: Grill done: 5 lines written by owner-standin; 4 DesignQuestions (Q-JP7D58, Q-ZTTBCH, Q-WZ3QQY, Q-V99SRH), each with the base rival and the #141 rivals, all to be tested by replayed runs. Waiting for the owner: none. Next for the owner: add the build Goal after the selects (hyp-goal-run's review recording, the cap text in docs/how-hyp-improves-itself.md, any hyp prompt default).
